name: Microscopic Self-Shadowing Microflake Model
definition: An extension of the standard microflake model that introduces correlations of microflake positions at a microscopic scale, leading to microscopic shadowing and masking. It uses a shadowing function A to control attenuation, single scattering, and multiple scattering independently.
summary: The Microscopic Self-Shadowing Microflake Model is a physically-based participating medium model that accounts for microscopic shadowing and masking effects by introducing correlations of microflake positions at a microscopic scale.
